objects.description: [DRYHOOK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9013) has encrypted stolen credentials strings within a file using both Base64 and RC4 with a hard-coded key.(Citation: Google UNC5221 Ivanti January 2025)(Citation: Picus Security UNC5221 Ivanti May 2025)
